name: Wasm Wars
author: Daniel Kiyoshi
description: A turn-based tactics game in the style of Advance Wars: move your units across a map of roads, forests and cities.

descriptions.en: A turn-based tactics game in the style of Advance Wars: move your units across a map of roads, forests and cities.
descriptions.it: Uno strategico a turni in stile Advance Wars: muovi le tue unità su una mappa di strade, foreste e città.
